topic.title: Platform-Specific Output
topic.shortdesc: Targeting specific e-book platforms: Amazon KDP, Apple Books, Kobo, and generic EPUB readers.

body.p: Not all reading systemsreading systems are created equal. While the EPUB 3.3 specification defines a standard, each major platform has its own requirements, quirks, and optimizations. The epub.platform parameter tells the plugin which platform you are targeting, and it adjusts the output accordingly.

row.entry: Standard EPUB 3.3 with no platform-specific modifications
NCX forced, OPF guide element, cover image validation, KDP CSS
Standard EPUB 3.3 compliance, Kobo CSS optimizations

body.p: Platform names are case-insensitive: KDP, kdp, and Kdp all resolve to the same configuration.
